invariants.claim: A successful non-burn update has passed the local-address, factory-implementation, and applicable same-factory raffle-registry destination screen before any ERC-721 mutation.

After super._update succeeds, _owners[ticketId] equals to; an existing owner's balance was decremented, a nonzero recipient's balance was incremented, token approval was cleared for an existing token, and Transfer was emitted.
previousOwner equals the _ownerOf(ticketId) value observed before the inherited ledger writes.
A nonzero auth is checked as owner, operator, or token-approved address before ledger mutation; zero auth skips that check.
Burns skip destination classification and preserve the historical _ticketRanges entry while deleting current ERC-721 ownership through super._update.

assumptions.claim: The canonical immutable factory responds with ABI-decodable raffleImplementation() and isRaffle(address) values when the relevant helper branches call them.
assumptions.establishedBy: Raffle stores its deployer as factory at target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L155-L164; RaffleFactory deploys the implementation and declares both public values at target/packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol:L42-L54, L89-L91.

assumptions.claim: For auth == address(0), operation-specific validity and authority are supplied by the wrapper/caller rather than by _update.

calls.propagates: Classifies each nonzero recipient against local protocol addresses, the factory implementation, and conditionally the factory raffle registry before ownership mutation (Raffle.sol:L498-L500, L593-L604).
Supplies the immutable implementation identity used in destination classification; a call/decode failure propagates before super._update (Raffle.sol:L598-L601; RaffleFactory.sol:L42, L89-L91).
For an otherwise-unclassified destination with code, supplies same-factory registration state written by createRaffle (Raffle.sol:L602-L604; RaffleFactory.sol:L54, L123-L128).
Establishes nonzero-auth authorization, clears token approval, updates balances and owner, emits Transfer, and returns the prior owner across mint/transfer/burn shapes (ERC721.sol:L216-L244).

Safe mint/transfer completion depends on the contract recipient returning the acceptance selector; receiver failure is reverted/bubbled and nested calls occur after the ownership write (ERC721.sol:L127-L136, L279-L290, L360-L363; ERC721Utils.sol:L25-L48).
